answer: Escalating proof of work prices each new identity by the crowd it joins: registering from a subnet, payout wallet or funding source already shared by k agents demands puzzle work that doubles with k. One honest agent on its own island pays a trivial puzzle once, but a farm feeding N heads from one lagoon of funds pays 1, 2, 4... 2^N units, and splitting into fresh wallets each needs real onyx-hard capital to seed.
